notes_for_editor: Build date and builder are unknown in every source read; the register lists Built as Unknown. The access level 'restricted' is an editorial judgment from the register's description of a state office site, not a stated policy. The 2023 visitor called the tower climbable; the story does not present that as a visiting option. Register gives ownership as the State of Tennessee; the record says ownership unknown. No new photos. Sources are from 2014 and 2023; no post-2023 condition report was found.
